extracted.intended_audience: researchers/authors considering submission to BMC Medicine (biomedical and sociomedical fields)
extracted.subtask_short: submitting biomedical manuscripts to BMC Medicine
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and expectations for authors submitting research and related manuscripts to the BMC Medicine journal, including scope, peer-review policy, editorial processes, and special collection calls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and topical fit
rubrics_metrics.description: Manuscripts should be of broad interest to the biomedical and sociomedical professional communities and cover areas such as clinical practice, translational medicine, medical and health advances, public health, global health, policy, and general topics of interest to a global readership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page states: 'BMC Medicine is an open access, open peer review medical journal publishing outstanding and influential research of broad interest to the biomedical and sociomedical professional communities. We cover all areas of clinical practice, translational medicine, medical and health advances, public health, global health, policy, and general topics of interest to our global readership.' Use this scope to judge topical fit before submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality and impact (outstanding and influential research)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preference for 'outstanding and influential research' that can inspire progress on clinical and health outcomes and have impact on future research, practice, and policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal emphasizes publishing work that is 'outstanding and influential' and 'committed to inspiring progress on clinical and health outcomes for people worldwide.' Authors should highlight significance, novelty, and potential policy/practice implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access and open peer review policy
rubrics_metrics.description: BMC Medicine is an open access, open peer review medical journal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions will be handled under the journal's open access model and open peer review process; authors should be prepared for transparent peer review and the implications of open access publishing (e.g., licensing, visibility).

rubrics_metrics.name: Portable Peer Review acceptance
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal aims to expedite decision-making for manuscripts with reviews received at high-tier journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under 'Portable Peer Review' the journal indicates it will consider prior peer reviews from high-tier journals to speed up editorial decisions. Authors with transferable reviews can submit these to potentially accelerate the process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial standards: rigorous processes and rapid handling
rubrics_metrics.description: A highly responsive team of professional editors ensures rigorous processes and rapid publication upon acceptance; median submission to first decision is 3 days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page highlights both rigor and speed ('rigorous processes and rapid publication upon acceptance' and 'Submission to first decision (median) 3 days'). Authors should ensure manuscripts meet quality standards while expecting prompt initial decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author support, visibility, and dissemination
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal is dedicated to supporting authors by providing global visibility, innovative formats, widespread promotion, and opportunities for impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: BMC Medicine promises author support and promotion—authors can expect assistance with dissemination and are encouraged to consider how their manuscript could be presented in innovative formats or promoted for broad impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Themed collections and calls for papers
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal issues calls for papers for themed Collections (e.g., impacts of social media on children, treatment/management of MASH/MASLD, ultra-processed food and health) with open submission windows and deadlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors whose work aligns with active Collections should consider submitting to those calls and note submission deadlines. Themed Collections signal priority topics and may influence editorial consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal performance metrics (for author consideration)
rubrics_metrics.description: Journal Impact Factor (8.3, 2024), 5-year Impact Factor (9.4, 2024), downloads (10.4M, 2025) and indexing/abstracting services are presented as indicators of the journal's reach and standing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These metrics can help authors assess the journal's visibility and potential reach. The page lists indexing in many services (e.g., PubMedCentral, SCOPUS, Science Citation Index Expanded) which may matter for authors' dissemination goals.
